surface: Firmware update and rollback (key=fwupdate) — secure-world CMD_FW_BEGIN/CHUNK/COMMIT/STATUS/ABORT streaming updater (`secure/src/fw_update/`, `secure/src/nsc/cmd_fw_*.rs`), the legacy bench FSBL A/B selector (`fsbl/`), the v0x02/`PQFW_V1` manifest + Draft-1.1 `PQFW_V6` pure core (`fw-manifest/`), the host signer (`fwsign/`), the rejected unary OTP floor + boot-state page (`secure/src/hw/{otp,boot_state}.rs`), the nonshipping `pqsigner-rollback`/`pqsigner-geometry` cores, and the reproducible-build/measurement chain. Read-only inventory at branch feat/pq1-board-target (HEAD c75b0d9c), 2026-10-10. Headline: the vendor-signature/verify-chain/staging half is implemented and FI-hardened on both the update and boot paths, but there is NO working anti-rollback backend, NO working A/B try-once recovery, NO activation path in COMMIT (fail-closed refusal since FA-1.5), and every production/real-key/factory build is compile-blocked by build.rs + Rust fences; the whole surface is bench-only by construction.

has.item: Unified verify chain at BEGIN (structural -> CRC -> digest -> vendor fpr -> C10 signature -> rollback floor), timing-normalised (every step runs on every input), with signature/digest/rollback verdicts routed through fi::check_true_into_sentinel + scrub_sentinel_register (F-7/F15)
has.notes: Reports errors in documented chain order after all work is done. Only reachable under stm32u585 (module is cfg-gated; QEMU never dispatches CMD_FW_*, issue #167).

has.item: Vendor SPHINCS+C10 public key baked into BOTH the secure image and the FSBL in a dedicated allocated ELF section `.pqsigner.vendor_pubkey`, consumed via key_parts() (single runtime copy, black_box'd); fwsign release gate hashes that section from the final ELFs
has.notes: Secure-side verify uses the compiled-in key, NOT the running slot's manifest fpr (contradicts firmware-update.md 'Known gotchas' — see drift).

has.item: Build-script + Rust compile fences: stm32u585+mode-production -> FW_ROLLBACK_PRODUCTION_BLOCKED; factory-provisioning -> FW_ROLLBACK_FACTORY_BLOCKED; bench STM32 builds must opt in with `legacy-fw-rollback-unsafe`; real production vendor key (policy-hash match) cannot compose with the legacy backend outside mode-production (FW_ROLLBACK_REAL_KEY_BLOCKED, #541 measurement-profile carve-out); all-zero/relative/dev key rejected for production
has.notes: rollback_ship_fences runs real cargo builds and asserts the exact failure strings; enrolled in CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:182).

has.item: Production vendor-key policy intentionally `UNPROVISIONED`; release-pubkey-check refuses zero key, dev key, malformed/unprovisioned policy; `make release`/`_release`/`fsbl-release`/`prod-check`/`prod-check-ship` hard-$(error) at make-eval time
has.notes: No production packaging path exists; fwsign sign requires --legacy-bench-unsafe and emits only PQFW_V1 (fwsign/src/subcommands/sign.rs:47-54).

has.item: CMD_FW_BEGIN handler: PIN sentinel gate, exact 8 KB length, sentinel-gated NS read-pointer validation, volatile TOCTOU snapshot to S-stack, static one-shot trusted-UI authorization BEFORE the verifier runs, wait_random jitter, verify chain, image-length-vs-slot-capacity bound (the SOLE bound on the unsigned len fields), trusted-display install confirm (version/direction + fw fingerprint + key fingerprint + prompt) BEFORE any flash op, inactive slot chosen from hardware VTOR (not boot-state), erase inactive slot, seed SRAM ctx
has.notes: ui-px screens exist for both prompts (secure/src/ui/px/status_map.rs:436,477). confirm_install is short-circuited under e2e-test (mod.rs:121-125) — fenced out of production. SESSION_COUNTER is bumped but discarded (cmd_fw_begin.rs:226) and STATUS has no session field: documented contract not wired (#138).

has.item: CMD_FW_CHUNK: HandlerGuard (blocks SysTick idle-wipe during the mutable borrow), PIN gate, bounded total_len, sentinel-gated pointer validation, snapshot, declared-vs-actual len check, strict monotonic append with checked_add on offset+len AND base+offset, QW-aligned writes via write_slot_quadword_verified with 0xFF pad on the final short chunk, hasher bumped only after a successful write
has.notes: Host pure tests pin these (secure/src/fw_update_boot_pure_tests.rs:545-905).

has.item: COMMIT-time verify_images: length match, running-hash vs fresh volatile flash re-hash vs manifest signed hashes, all constant-time compares, aggregate verdict re-evaluated inside check_true_into_sentinel with black_box after wait_random; failure drops the context (retry needs a fresh user-gated BEGIN), never arms a wipe
has.notes: Closed the 'COMMIT single-fault bypass' audit finding; rainbow FI sweep over this function still untracked-as-executed (#591).

has.item: CMD_FW_COMMIT activation: REMOVED. After verify_images it writes the inactive manifest page with try_once=TRIED (CRC recomputed), writes the boot-state page, re-verifies the staged manifest FROM FLASH (structural/CRC/digest/verify_rollback(new_version-1)) + boot-state pointer through sentinel gates, then unconditionally returns FwUpdateFlashError with no OTP program, no floor write, no reset (FA-1.5, commit 2bad0c86)
has.notes: There is no success path in any build. The staged slot can still be selected by the FSBL at next reset under its own re-verification (legacy try-once fall-through), so staging is diagnostic, not activation. The retained FI gate is source-level only ('not live FI coverage today', cmd_fw_commit.rs:288-294). `otp::bump_to` has zero Rust call sites.

gaps.gap: No valid anti-rollback backend: the unary OTP tally is physically invalid on STM32U585 ECC quad-words, the runtime floor writer is removed, and no replacement physical codec (OPEN-OTP-1..3, OPEN-ECC-1, OPEN-JRN-HW-1, OPEN-JRN-DUR-1) is selected. A validly-signed downgrade is therefore only blocked by a floor that can never move past its factory value.
gaps.notes: CLAUDE.md invariant #10 + 'Rollback manifest work is not implementation-approved'. docs/STATUS.md FW-RB row says implementation NO-GO.

gaps.gap: No field activation path at all: CMD_FW_COMMIT always refuses after staging, so a user cannot install an update on any build; FSBL may still pick the staged slot at next reset via the legacy fall-through, which is undefined behaviour from the product's perspective.
gaps.tracked_in: #540 (FA-1 floor-writer removal), #696 (MP: CMD_FW_* is the ONLY field path once BOOT0 is strapped + RDP-2)

FSBL immutability is not implemented: WRP is never programmed anywhere in the tree, no software guard excludes FSBL/manifest/boot-state pages from erase_secure_page/write_quadword_verified, `updater_must_preserve` is deliberately not enforced (bank-2 FSBL mirror pages 0..4 lie inside live NS slot A), geometry cutover to 40 KiB is blocked because page 4 is Manifest A and boot-state has no registry page.

The signed bundle does not bind the FSBL: a different FSBL boots the unchanged signed bundle (demonstrated on silicon 2026-09-28); FSBL identity rests only on out-of-band measurement until WRP+RDP-2 close. No vendor-pubkey OTP hash lock exists.
